note: The script asks for the hook text and one name super, then the client's end card. Row 00:03–00:06 also asks for a highlight inside the caption, and captions are the editor's, so there is no graphic for that.

mg.title: Hook text
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: YOU MADE THIS POSSIBLE. Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:02.5. Top third, big, bold. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:03 for 2.5 s, lower left above the captions: Kerri Colfer / Director of Policy and Research, NIWRC.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:03 for 2.5 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line Director of Policy and Research, NIWRC under the name.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: Your approved NIWRC end card, white logo on NIWRC red. Logo only here.
mg.src: NIWRC logo (white) from NIWRC's onboarding brand file, in the brand kit 10 Oct 2026 (endcards/index.json). Client rule: white logo on red.
mg.use: This is the end card. Put it right after her 1 s hold at 00:10 and hold it to the end. Music out.
